correctness.rationale: On x,y>0, direct h cofactor dh/dt=-xy |grad h|²h yields strict monotonic h² off regular zero level and rules out all other nonconstant periodic orbits. At mu>337/9 Craciun–Erban Lemma 13 establishes precisely four regular ovals, inside [1,3]^2. On h=0 the speed is eps xy |grad h|, so normal multiplier rho=exp[-(1/eps)∮|grad q|ds]; four quarter-turned lobes share the geometric integral. Polar quadratic in r² has discriminant Delta=49-9(mu-32)sin²(2theta), yielding exact branch period quadrature. Reflection reverses 2+u to 2-u, making strict T_right<T_left, while x/y exchange gives equality R=T and L=B. Node weights 169/25,91/25,49/25 give logarithmic coefficients (1/28)(25/169+25/91)=125/8281 and (1/28)(25/91+25/49)=125/4459; ratio 13/7. Direct symbolic integration of critical divergence-area integral 12600∫_0^1(625-49z²)/(576+49z²)² dz verified exactly Ic=8407/400 + (1225/384)atan(7/24)=21.92283277026..., positive. Independently reconstructed branch integrals numerically for mu=38,39,100,mu_c+10^-3,mu_c+10^-5; all have periods positive and strict split; finite quadrature checks support but do not prove the asymptotic remainder. The proof uses endpoint collar estimates.
